name: Timezone Converter
tagline: Convert time between world time zones
description: Convert a specific time from one timezone to another. See what time it is right now in any city or timezone. Uses the free WorldTimeAPI — no API key required.

expert_defs.name: timezone_converter_convert
expert_defs.description: Gets current time or converts a datetime to a timezone using worldtimeapi.org. Params: timezone (IANA timezone like America/New_York), datetime_str (optional ISO datetime). Returns JSON with output_type json.
code: result = {'timezone': tz, 'current_datetime': dt_str[:19].replace('T', ' '), 'utc_offset': data.get('utc_offset', ''), 'day_of_week': days[day_of_week], 'dst': data.get('dst', False), 'abbreviation': data.get('abbreviation', ''), 'unix_time': data.get('unixtime', 0)}

conceptTexts: Plugin: Timezone Converter (id: timezone-converter). Expert timezone_converter_convert returns current time in any IANA timezone using worldtimeapi.org. Param: timezone (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {timezone, current_datetime, utc_offset, day_of_week, dst}}.
